result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel contains duplicated restaurant entries and the favorite (heart) buttons use inconsistent styling between cards.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Green Bowl Poké' twice as the first two cards, with identical image, delivery time (15–25 min) and delivery fee (€0.90), suggesting a duplicate item in the data set.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list before rendering the carousel (e.g., unique by restaurant ID) so each venue appears only once.

issues.description: The favorite heart button on the 'Popular right now' cards is inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent style (background color, icon color, and border) to all favorite buttons, ensuring adequate contrast over any image.

issues.description: Badges overlaid on card images (e.g., '€0 delivery', '−20%', '15–25 min') and heart icons rely on image backgrounds for contrast; on lighter photos the text/icon contrast may fall below accessible thresholds.
issues.suggestion: Add a consistent solid or scrim background behind overlay badges and icons to guarantee sufficient contrast regardless of the underlying image.
